Ninotchka
A playboy (Melvyn Douglas) charms a Russian envoy (Greta Garbo) sent to fetch three wayward comrades in Paris.
Deep Valley
A shy California farm girl (Ida Lupino) falls in love with a fugitive (Dane Clark) from a chain gang.
All the President's Men
The Washington Post's Bob Woodward (Robert Redford) and Carl Bernstein (Dustin Hoffman) tie the Watergate break-in to the White House.
The Manchurian Candidate
A Korean War hero's (Laurence Harvey) commanding officer (Frank Sinatra) discovers he and his platoon were brainwashed.
The Battleship Potemkin
Sergei Eisenstein's classic film depicts the mutiny aboard a czarist battleship during the failed revolution of 1905.
Three Colors: Blue
A Frenchwoman (Juliette Binoche) tries to withdraw from life after her daughter and composer husband die in a car crash.
Three Colors: White
Divorced and ruined in Paris, a Polish hairdresser (Zbigniew Zamachowski) gets even with his French ex-wife (Julie Delpy).
The Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer Story
Actor Lionel Barrymore and Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer executive Dore Schary present clips from the studio's 1951 releases, including Quo Vadis.
Noah's Ark
The same couple (Dolores Costello, George O'Brien) appear in parallel dramas of the Deluge and World War I.
The Squall
A gypsy woman applies her feminine charms to the male members of a farmhouse where she takes refuge during a storm.
The Great Divide
Posing as a bandido, a businessman abducts a Roaring '20s flapper hoping to reform her.
Show of Shows
The Warner Bros. revue, with master of ceremonies (Frank Fay), begins with 192 dancing girls on a huge staircase.
The Truth About Youth
A naive young man becomes enamored of a cabaret singer who has sampled liberally from amongst the male population.
The Naughty Flirt
A spoiled heiress leaves her boyfriend only to become involved with a man who secretly desires her money.
Consolation Marriage
A sportswriter (Pat O'Brien) jilted by his globe-trotting girlfriend (Myrna Loy) marries a woman (Irene Dunne) jilted by her boyfriend.
Rebound
A woman (Ina Claire) tries to make her husband (Robert Ames) forget his old flame (Myrna Loy), who is back.
Libeled Lady
An editor's fiancée and a lawyer help him trick an heiress suing his paper.
I Love You Again
A businessman (William Powell) snaps out of 9-year amnesia, reverts to con man and falls in love with his wife (Myrna Loy).
Love Crazy
An old flame (Gail Patrick) and a mother-in-law make a couple's (William Powell, Myrna Loy) fourth anniversary wacky.
